_comment: Canonical sensor dictionary. expected_min/expected_max are SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT BOUNDS used to flag 'suspect' readings; they are NOT NASA sensor specifications. physical_min/physical_max are hard physical limits (e.g. absolute zero, 0-100 vol%) used to flag 'invalid' readings. Update source_status to 'verified_nasa_variable' only after confirming against official NASA PSI documentation.

sensors.description: Gas-phase temperature near the simulated flame zone (illustrative thermocouple-like point measurement).
sensors.expected_range_basis: Synthetic development bound chosen to cover ambient-to-flame temperatures; not a NASA specification.
sensors.missing_data_policy: Flag as 'missing'; never impute in canonical table; ML layer may interpolate within a run with the method recorded.

sensors.description: Chamber wall / ambient temperature away from the flame (illustrative).
sensors.expected_range_basis: Synthetic development bound; not a NASA specification.
sensors.missing_data_policy: Flag as 'missing'; never impute in canonical table.

sensors.description: Absolute pressure of the simulated combustion chamber.
sensors.expected_range_basis: Synthetic development bound spanning reduced-pressure to elevated-pressure scenarios; not a NASA specification.
sensors.missing_data_policy: Flag as 'missing'; never impute in canonical table.

sensors.description: Oxygen volume fraction of the chamber atmosphere.
sensors.expected_range_basis: Synthetic development bound; not a NASA specification.
sensors.missing_data_policy: Flag as 'missing'; never impute in canonical table.

sensors.expected_range_basis: Synthetic development bound; not a NASA specification.
sensors.missing_data_policy: Flag as 'missing'; never impute in canonical table.

sensors.description: Heat flux at a gauge/radiometer location (illustrative).
sensors.expected_range_basis: Synthetic development bound; not a NASA specification. No hard physical limit applied because net heat flux can be negative.
sensors.missing_data_policy: Flag as 'missing'; never impute in canonical table.

sensors.description: Flame radius or flame-front position, as typically derived from imaging rather than a physical sensor (illustrative). Zero means no flame.
